title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Trump reveals up to $100K Strategy stock purchase in ethics filing
summary: President Donald Trump disclosed a July purchase of Strategy shares as his administration continues to advance crypto policy through federal regulators and Congress.

title: US stablecoin adoption could surge with bank-like protections: Visa survey
summary: The survey released by Visa posited that bank-like protections for stablecoins could increase adoption in the US as companies are preparing for the enactment of the GENIUS Act.

title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
summary: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.

title: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
summary: Blockchain.com users could gain access to tokenized US stocks and ETFs through NYSE’s planned digital trading platform under a new partnership, as bourses rush to deliver new trading.

title: Bitcoin long liquidations hit $280M as BTC price dips under $84K
summary: Bitcoin long liquidations mounted as BTC/USD briefly traded below $84,000, while analysis flagged key support to hold.

title: Raiffeisen to offer crypto trading across 11 European markets via Bitpanda
summary: Bitpanda will provide crypto infrastructure to Raiffeisen network banks, potentially extending digital asset access to about 18 million customers.

title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
summary: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

title: Winners and losers of the SEC’s new tokenized stocks rules
summary: The SEC has opened a five-year path for tokenized stocks, but only some products and venues fit the model. Will Uniswap, Robinhood, Coinbase or Kraken come out on top?

title: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
summary: MoonPay’s North Capital acquisition adds US broker-dealer, trading and investment infrastructure as it expands into tokenized securities.
